input.prompt: Create ONE 16:9 photorealistic-natural WHAT IT COST documentary photographic asset, not a collage, graphic-design slide or poster. Everything photographed in one real physical setting. Small supporting ORIGINAL EDITORIAL WORKING NOTES, not official/company documents and not purported historical evidence. Print only the explicitly requested non-numeric analytical labels and notes, black ink, restrained normal serif. No invented prose, pseudo-writing, letterheads, seals, signatures, bank forms, case numbers, quotes, dates or monetary values. Real official sources and exact critical figures will be separate unchanged source/Fusion layers, never redraw them. No giant EDITORIAL ANALYSIS title, no generic A4 worksheet filling the screen. NO colored outlines, red/yellow accents, rectangles, arrows, underlines, highlights, source/provenance banners, glowing lines, counters, mechanisms, 3D diagrams, gold/marble, fake issued tickets or identification. No humans, faces, identifiable third-party brands. No device UI. Exact numbers/dates and analytical connectors are deliberately absent and will be editable Fusion nodes. Natural photographic restraint, not theatrical film prop styling. FINAL TEXT LOCK: Every visible printed word must be one of the specifically requested phrases. Never invent extra body copy to fill paper. Size each paper slip closely around its actual text instead of making large empty sheets; concise filled excerpt objects, not white-page placeholders. Original labels 'EARLIER PLEA' and 'LATER PLEA', supporting line 'Scope remains specific to the person and proceeding'. No date, exact legal term, judgment, quote, official document, signature or logo. No linkage implying guilt of unrelated defendants. Dark space above for separate dates.
